name: Prestidigitation
description:
You create a small, harmless magical effect within short range, like a flash of light, a breeze, a smell, sound or music, illusory color or a small symbol, lasting up to 1 minute.

You can also warm, cool, clean, stain, flavor or dry a nonliving object or part of an object no more than 1 ft in any dimension, or conjure, manipulate or snuff out small flames like a candle or torch.

Describe the effects.
